note: Per-trader trading volume from the public 42.space Market API. Rolling windows use period=1d|7d|30d|all. The points week uses from/to UTC calendar dates. Each block keeps the top 200 rows for the table. aggregate covers every trader returned for that window, including heuristic market-maker and bot detection. Labels come from wallet-labels.json.

points_api.note: latestWeek is the last distributed points week (exclusive end). It is not the in-progress week. The points route does not send Access-Control-Allow-Origin for third-party pages, so the browser reads this copy from the snapshot.

markets.note: Sum of the volume field on every market returned by GET /api/v1/markets. This is a lifetime market notional, not a windowed total, so it is only compared with the all-time trader sum.

week.method: GET /api/v1/market-data/leaderboard with from/to UTC calendar dates, inclusive. from is the Thursday date, to is the Wednesday date, matching Thursday 00:00 UTC through Wednesday 23:59 UTC. A future `to` is accepted and returns week-to-date.
